mapper.select: SELECT P.REVIEW_NO, P.ACCOMMODATION_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.RATING, P.CONTENT, P.CHECK_IN_DATE, P.CHECK_OUT_DATE, P.RECOMMENDED_FOR, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT, P.NICKNAME, P.PROFILE_IMAGE, P.VERIFIED_REVIEWER, I.IMAGE_NO, I.REVIEW_NO AS IMG_REVIEW_NO, I.IMAGE_URL, I.ORIGINAL_NAME, I.RENAMED_NAME, I.IMAGE_ORDER FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REVIEW_NO, R.ACCOMMODATION_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_IN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHECK_IN_DATE, TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_OUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHECK_OUT_DATE, R.RECOMMENDED_FOR, R.STATUS, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE, M.VERIFIED_REVIEWER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.ACCOMMODATION_NO = #{accommodationNo} AND R.STATUS = 'A' ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit} ) P LEFT JOIN REVIEW_IMAGE I ON P.REVIEW_NO = I.REVIEW_NO ORDER BY P.RN, I.IMAGE_ORDER

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.REVIEW_NO, R.ACCOMMODATION_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.RATING, R.CONTENT, TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_IN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHECK_IN_DATE, TO_CHAR(R.CHECK_OUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHECK_OUT_DATE, R.RECOMMENDED_FOR, R.STATUS, TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE, M.VERIFIED_REVIEWER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.ACCOMMODATION_NO = #{accommodationNo} AND R.STATUS = 'A' ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW WHERE ACCOMMODATION_NO = #{accommodationNo} AND STATUS = 'A'
SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) AS "avgRating", COUNT(*) AS "reviewCount" FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW WHERE ACCOMMODATION_NO = #{accommodationNo} AND STATUS = 'A'
